description: This file defines the SNPreferencesService class, which manages user preferences by interfacing with singleton storage, item management, and sync services in a TypeScript project. It includes methods for getting and setting preference values, handling application stages, observing events, and reloading preferences.

classes.name: SNPreferencesService
classes.description: A service class that manages user preferences, including loading, updating, reloading, and synchronization of preferences in the application.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up observers and references when the service is de-initialized.

methods.name: handleApplicationStage
methods.description: Handles different application stages, in particular loading and initializing preferences when the database is loaded.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a preference value by key, returning a default if not set.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a preference key to a given value and triggers synchronization.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads preferences from singleton storage, triggering change notifications if necessary.
